title: SCPN ICF Laser Core
description: Governed device-family repository for laser-driven inertial confinement fusion configurations (direct drive, indirect drive, fast/shock ignition) within the SCPN Reactor Systems Research Group. Evidence maturity computational_prototype: a validated device configuration model, diagnostic and clock semantics aligned with the SCPN Phase Orchestrator observability catalogue, level-0 device physics (the published hot-spot ignition condition, the definitions an imploding shell is quoted by, and the fuel inventory, yield and gain of a declared capsule), and tessellated and B-rep models of the capsule and, for indirect drive, its radiation enclosure. All parameter sets are synthetic or anchored on a filed review; no real machine is described, and the claim inventory is empty.
